chronology: Original contract was already accepted for bounded implementation. Supplement statements that implementation is unauthorized/pending are predecessor status, superseded by the prior Editor receipt and this additive acceptance. Immutable owner documents preserved unchanged.
accepted_definitions: Half-open pulse and exact interval overlap; scheme-compatible right-endpoint outlet/loss budgets.
Known total inlet required; inlet advective/dispersive split null unless a declared boundary reconstruction is supplied.
Exported-mass quantiles and interval-reconstructed temporal moments conditional on window/exported amount; no sharp first-arrival metric for positive dispersion.
Reconstructed resident spatial centroid/variance includes cell internal h^2/12 term, undefined at zero storage; distinct from breakthrough temporal width.
Recovery/loss/storage normalized by each actual dose, retaining absolute dose and remaining storage.
Four illustrative core scenarios: conservative and reactive baseline; conservative 2u and 2D_L, fixed physical pulse duration and other physical inputs.
E05 only candidate k changes with fixed known transport/feed and identical observation intervals; synthetic truth/noise provenance explicit.
Export schema and bounded P02 E06 scope compatible with teaching0.2; no workload/ID/rubric change.

accepted_pre_run_targets.metric_refinement: abs(refined-base)<=0.02*max(abs(refined),floor); floors 0.01*C_ref peak, 0.01*tau_a time/temporal width, 0.01*L spatial width.
accepted_pre_run_targets.fraction_accuracy: Absolute refinement change <=0.005 for recovery/loss/storage fractions; distinct from algebraic budget residual.
accepted_pre_run_targets.conservative_washout: Storage/input <=0.001 plus quantile/width stability under extended window. Otherwise label finite-window metrics.
accepted_pre_run_targets.original_gates: Retain original B01-B08 residual/positivity/smooth-order and independent grid/time/profile accuracy gates. Declare profile norm/normalization and zero branch before default selection.
accepted_pre_run_targets.qualification: Targets are verification requirements, not observed passes. No mesh/time/window default is accepted yet; record failures and cost.

next_required_deliverable: One frozen implemented and executed scientific package with code, inputs, profiles/flux/budgets/checks, independent refinements, bounded scenarios and synthetic observation/residual support.
